title: The readiness verdict names the sections of an EmDash template that hold content-map slots and are no block of its template kit
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database, no stand, no model).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: An EmDash section with visual slots and no kit block (named after its entry, contained by a block, or holding the slot by id) is named by kit-sections-missing, todo, or warn once shown on Design inspiration.
A section a block is named after, contains or holds slots of, non-visual slots, the settings, page entries, posts and the chrome are not named.
When the map assigns sections to pages, a section printed only on a page outside the kit is ignored.
Joomla keeps kit-modules-missing unchanged, and a WordPress release gets nothing.

tests: EmDash: a section with visual slots and no block is named
EmDash: with the pages that print each section
EmDash: the judge names the sections
a published public module with slots
